chunks.heading: This Website
chunks.text: Static site served entirely from AWS — the site is its own case study. Registered domain transferred from GoDaddy to Route 53 (including tearing down a stale DNSSEC chain — DS records deleted at the .dev registry before the nameserver cutover, so resolution never broke). Hosted from S3, fronted by CloudFront with a free ACM certificate. The .dev TLD is HSTS-preloaded, so every connection is HTTPS by force. Keyless CI/CD — OIDC-federated deploys, no stored credentials; every deploy verified byte-for-byte against the commit Security headers at the edge — CSP script-src 'none' ; zero JavaScript Self-testing monitoring — alarm → SNS → Lambda → SES, with a monthly heartbeat that shares no failure modes with the path it tests Full write-ups and infrastructure code on GitHub → S3 CloudFront Route 53 ACM DNSSEC GitHub OIDC CloudFront Functions Lambda SES EventBridge In development

chunks.heading: Retrieval-Augmented Chatbot on Amazon Bedrock
chunks.text: Hands-on build alongside the AWS AI Practitioner certification track. A RAG chatbot that answers questions from a personal document corpus instead of hallucinating from general knowledge. Built to understand the retrieval pipeline from the inside — chunking, embedding, and grounding — rather than treating the model as a black box. This page updates as the build progresses. Amazon Bedrock RAG Embeddings Python Shipped

chunks.heading: Gmail & Drive Automation Suite
chunks.text: github.com/ryan-grey/gmail-drive-automation Google Apps Script suite that classifies, labels, and archives a 15+-year mailbox by year, plus rule-based cloud file organization. Engineered around Apps Script execution-time limits and the long tail of edge-case messages that break naive classifiers. A decade and a half of inbox, organized by code instead of by weekend. Google Apps Script Gmail API Drive API JavaScript In production

chunks.heading: AI-Assisted Commerce Operations
chunks.text: A working pipeline that runs a real multi-marketplace resale operation. End-to-end workflow automation for online resale: an image-processing pipeline (including a custom HEIC decoder built from format parsing + ffmpeg when standard libraries failed), automated market-comp research, listing copy generation, photo collage tooling for platform limits, and engagement-driven repricing across 40+ concurrent listings. Listing creation went from ~30 minutes of manual work to minutes; repricing decisions are driven by per-listing engagement data instead of guesswork. LLM agents Python Image processing Browser automation Pricing analytics
